strings.name: Angus Deaton
strings.summary: Deaton uses household surveys and microeconomic evidence to study consumption, poverty and welfare. He developed demand analysis with Muellbauer and examined American mortality and inequality with Anne Case. Awarded the 2015 economics prize, he became Princeton emeritus in 2016 and continued research and writing on health, global development and economic methods.
